ana: Orion asked for per-route cost + basic trace hooks for Dedicated. Need a minimal scope we can ship fast.

mike: What does "basic" mean? cost rows + on-demand traces?

ana: Minimal: hourly per-route cost estimates, sampling toggle (metadata-only), small "recent spans" modal, alert when errors spike. RBAC + audit required.

sophia: Acceptance criteria: filterable cost table, sampling control, one-click trace peek, alert links to traces. Phase the UX.

jeff: Storage note: metadata-only sampling much cheaper. Full span fetch on demand. For 1% sampling we estimate ~25GB/week. Need to confirm with infra.
mike: Implementation plan: cost aggregator job (hourly), trace sampler flag + forwarder, UI table + modal, alert wiring. Alpha estimate 3 dev-weeks.
sophia: UX: show small inline cost per route, tooltip about sampling tradeoffs. Phase 1 mocks by Tue.

ana: Sales needs a short spec for the customer by tomorrow: SLA for cost latency (<5m), canary plan (10% traffic), rollback if ingestion backlog >1h or cost mismatch >5%.

jeff: I'll add storage/cost numbers and encryption checklist.

ops-bot: Created ticket RED-4899: "Orion: per-route cost + trace hooks (alpha)" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-4899

mike: I'll open the draft API PR today.

ana: Thanks team, will sync Fri 10am if needed.
